goal: Verify that a user can create a new Site Host account and successfully navigate the calendar view from June 2026 to August 2026.
instructions: On the 'Create your account' page, enter 'alice' into the 'Username' field and 'SecureP@ss123!' into the 'Password' field, then click the 'Sign up' button.
Once the dashboard loads showing the 'June 2026' calendar, click the 'Next month' button (right arrow) to advance the view to July 2026.
Click the 'Next month' button again to advance the calendar view from July 2026 to August 2026.
success_criteria: The user is successfully logged in and the 'Create your account' form is no longer visible.
The calendar header updates to display 'July 2026' after the first navigation action.
The calendar header updates to display 'August 2026' after the second navigation action.
The main content area displays a list of existing memos or reminders without any error messages.
